main.description: An event on Jeff's timeline (/timeline/). Records are public, so until it's over an event holds only its kind, its days and its city, unless it's announced; the title, times, place, note and link are added after (docs/v4/timeline.md).

kind.description: What kind of event, shown as its label while it has no title.

endsOn.description: A date (YYYY-MM-DD): the last day. Leave it empty for a one-day event.

announced.description: Its details are public before it's over, e.g. a talk.

startTime.description: A time (HH:MM) on the first day, in the event's time zone. Leave it empty for all day.

endTime.description: A time (HH:MM) on the last day, in the event's time zone.

timeZone.description: IANA time zone for its times, e.g. 'Europe/Paris'. Bangkok's if empty.

note.description: Markdown, rendered like a post's text: paragraphs, links, bold and italics.

link.description: A path on skiddle.id, e.g. a post written about it (/posts/…/), or a full URL.
